boundaries: GET checks are APIRequestContext requests, separately labelled from actual rendered UI clicks.
Default attempts permit only UI login; an opt-in marked attempt permits one designated owner p99 figure note PUT.
No model requests, model-list provider requests, grading, generation, or draft saves are made.
Plan and mistake data have course-level read endpoints; no nonexistent individual GET is claimed.
Anonymous SPA routes render the login screen; API URLs return JSON 401 instead of an HTML redirect.
Resource IDs, credentials, textbook/user content and complete exceptions are kept private.
